method.unit: game seconds at 1× (decision rooms pause the run; 2×/4× speed divides wall-clock time)
method.informationModel: runner.mjs header: lamps / previews / prices / map adjacency / climate preview only — no validator witness, no rng, no future pressure
method.human: notice delay 2–6 s after a target becomes affordable; 35–80 % of Biomass bubbles clicked after 2–4 s (the rest auto-collect at half value)

sample.stream: bloom-038 design audit expedition pool v1

method.cap: 3600 s (training 1800 s); a run that neither Blooms nor goes extinct by the cap is a TIMEOUT (Expedition has no extinction loss)

definitions.firstMeaningfulDecision: first second at which a purchase that opens reachable land / reaches across water / speeds a large uncovered frontier is affordable
definitions.biomassSaving: seconds with a chosen target the policy could not yet afford (waiting for Biomass)
definitions.noUsefulAction: seconds with no legal purchase that the previews show opens, reaches or measurably improves frontier land
definitions.meaningfulPurchase: a purchase whose preview opened reachable land (unlock) or that made other landmasses reachable (Waterborne Seeds)
definitions.waitAfterSolved: won runs: seconds from the later of (strategically solved, last purchase after it) to Bloom — pure waiting
